title: Wedge
prompt: a door wedge beside a hinged model door on a table with three buttons: “Insert” drives the wedge under the door and lifts it; “Pull” removes the wedge and frees the door; “Load” increases the door weight and the resisting force; see-through reveals the sloping contact faces and force arrows splitting the push into upward and sideways forces
blurb: Push a sloping wedge under a model door to lift it, then add weight to see the forces increase.
adaptation: Teaching adaptation of the supported wedge principle, not a reproduction of a book illustration.

provenance.2016: Direct page support, printed page 11; source audit now-pages.json index 12.
